title: Read live acceptance criteria during and after task preparation
description: Read-only. Select an authenticated gateway profile, owned FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_TAB, FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_RUN_ID, FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_OUTPUT and FARMSLOT_AC_PROOF_PHASE=pre-task or task. Run once while a naturally scheduled run is writing its task and again after. Never changes run or UI state.

read-criteria.intent: Read the actual run through authenticated RPC and its connected Command Center panel. Prove one-level criterion text and no false zero tally; before the task, show registered criteria or quiet preparation without a ledger error.
